Only downloads image assets when asset_types filter is set

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"asset_types\":[\"image\"],\"download_assets\":true}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(length(result.assets))
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.assets, 0).asset_category)
```
